manifest.name: Date stamp
manifest.description: Insert a local date stamp into the active note from the command palette.
manifest.author: Noor Note

files.main.js: noorNote.register({kind:'command',id:'insert-date',title:'Insert date stamp',category:'Editor'}, async () => { const date = new Date(); const stamp = date.getFullYear() + '-' + String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0'); await noorNote.request('editor.insert', {text: stamp}); });
